notes: Gear upgrades from the auction house work after a scan again. The game reads the scanned items many times faster (it only reads each item's tooltip now: the program counts every gear scale itself), and a new scan or a new level no longer throws away what was read before. The chat says how long it takes and when the items are ready.
If the game has not read every scanned item yet, the slot's panel says how many are left.
A copy button next to every item on the auction house list: one press puts its name on the clipboard for the game's auction house search.
The slot's panel can show items up to your level only, or two levels above it too; the choice is remembered. The panel is wider and its choices stand side by side.
New stat weights for leveling: priest (the wand counts most), Elemental and Enhancement shaman; Balance druid at 60.
Addon 0.8.3; the full scan of the auction house goes faster too.
